records.context: the Gaussian blur before the maxima are found, in pixels. This is separate from the image enhancement chain's denoise, which has already run by the time a detector sees the image: the blur that gives one object one centre is usually much stronger than the blur wanted for measuring the object's edge, and the propagation measures the edge on the same blurred image. Leave the chain's denoise off unless the microscope field of view is genuinely noisy, or the two blurs compound.

The animated backdrop and its optional GL canvas are the only things spaCR asks a driver to do at startup.
records.translation: 충돌 로그에는 `Fatal Python error: Segmentation fault` 및 `Aborted`가 기록되고, 충돌한 스레드에는 `<no Python frame>`이 표시됩니다 -- 결함은 네이티브 코드, 즉 Qt의 렌더링 스레드나 GL 드라이버에 있으며, 그곳에는 보고할 Python 스택이 없고 어떤 `except`도 실행될 수 없습니다. 움직이는 배경 효과와 선택적 GL 캔버스는 spaCR가 시작할 때 드라이버에 요청하는 유일한 작업입니다.

records.context: Mask generation applies the same chain. The image steps -- everything before ``detect`` -- are written as Mask settings by :func:`chain_settings`, one ``enhance_<field>`` structured-data name per :data:`SETTINGS_FIELDS` entry, and read back by :func:`spacr.psf_pipeline.prepare_chain`, which the V1 and V2 Mask workflows and the Mask Live preview apply to every selected segmentation image data channel after illumination correction and before normalization, at the stage the PSF already ran. Morphology and split act on a detector's labels and are Make Masks' own; a plate processing session's Cellpose labels are not reshaped by them. The Mask settings ``remove_background``, ``background`` and ``signal_to_noise`` are per-image data channel intensity floors applied by normalization afterwards, and :func:`spacr.object._preprocess_batch` is the organelle batches' own rolling ball and CLAHE; neither is configured here.
records.label: spacr.qt.detect_chain#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context

Morphology and split act on a detector's labels and are Make Masks' own; a plate run's Cellpose labels are not reshaped by them. The Mask settings ``remove_background``, ``background`` and ``signal_to_noise`` are per-channel intensity floors applied by normalization afterwards, and :func:`spacr.object._preprocess_batch` is the organelle batches' own rolling ball and CLAHE; neither is configured here.
records.translation: 마스크 생성도 같은 체인을 적용합니다. 이미지 단계 -- ``detect`` 이전의 모든 것 -- 는 :func:`chain_settings` 함수가 Mask 설정으로 기록하며(``enhance_<field>`` 키 하나가 :data:`SETTINGS_FIELDS` 항목 하나에 대응), :func:`spacr.psf_pipeline.prepare_chain` 함수가 다시 읽습니다. V1 및 V2 Mask 파이프라인과 Mask Live 미리 보기는 조명 보정 후 정규화 전, 즉 PSF가 이미 실행되던 단계에서 선택된 모든 분할 채널에 이 함수를 적용합니다. 형태학 연산과 분할은 검출기의 레이블에 작용하며 Make Masks 고유의 것으로, 플레이트 실행의 Cellpose 레이블은 이들에 의해 바뀌지 않습니다. Mask 설정의 ``remove_background``, ``background``, ``signal_to_noise``는 이후 정규화가 적용하는 채널별 강도 하한이며, :func:`spacr.object._preprocess_batch` 함수는 소기관 배치 자체의 rolling ball 및 CLAHE입니다. 둘 다 여기서 구성하지 않습니다.

records.context: Found through ``findChildren`` rather than by walking the menu bar's actions and calling ``QAction.menu()``. That reading is the obvious one and it does not survive on PySide6 6.11: the QMenu wrapper it returns is only valid while the QAction wrapper it came off is alive, so the menu went stale the moment this function returned — "Internal C++ object (PySide6.QtWidgets.QMenu) already deleted" on the very next line — and keeping the owners alive as attributes segfaulted during the next event dispatch instead. ``findChildren`` hands back children the menu bar owns in C++, which stay valid for as long as the window does.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Found through ``findChildren`` rather than by walking the menu bar's actions and calling ``QAction.menu()``. That reading is the obvious one and it does not survive on PySide6 6.11: the QMenu wrapper it returns is only valid while the QAction wrapper it came off is alive, so the menu went stale the moment this function returned — "Internal C++ object (PySide6.QtWidgets.QMenu) already deleted" on the very next line — and keeping the owners alive as attributes segfaulted during the next event dispatch instead. ``findChildren`` hands back children the menu bar owns in C++, which stay valid for as long as the window does.
records.translation: ``findChildren``으로 찾으며, 메뉴 표시줄의 작업을 순회하며 ``QAction.menu()``를 호출하는 방식은 쓰지 않습니다. 앞의 방식이 자연스러운 방법이지만 PySide6 6.11에서는 동작하지 않습니다. 반환된 QMenu 래퍼는 그것을 꺼낸 QAction 래퍼가 살아 있는 동안만 유효하므로, 이 함수가 반환하는 순간 메뉴가 무효가 되었고 — 바로 다음 줄에서 "Internal C++ object (PySide6.QtWidgets.QMenu) already deleted"가 발생했으며 — 소유자를 속성으로 살려 두면 대신 다음 이벤트 처리 중에 세그멘테이션 오류가 났습니다. ``findChildren``은 메뉴 표시줄이 C++에서 소유하는 자식을 돌려주며, 이는 창이 살아 있는 동안 계속 유효합니다.

records.context: The scale is applied without editing the call sites. records.context: ``QPixmap.scaled(w, h, ...)`` takes DEVICE pixels but every caller in a GUI means LOGICAL ones -- the size the picture should occupy on application view. On a display with a device pixel ratio of 2, which is every retina Mac and plenty of Windows and Linux machines, Qt then stretches that logical bitmap across twice as many real pixels in each direction: a 200 px render blown up to 400 px, from a 3334 px source. The picture is not low-resolution; the scaling threw the resolution away.

records.translation: ``QPixmap.scaled(w, h, ...)``는 장치 픽셀을 받지만, GUI의 모든 호출자가 뜻하는 것은 논리 픽셀, 즉 그림이 화면에서 차지해야 할 크기입니다. 장치 픽셀 비율이 2인 디스플레이(모든 레티나 Mac과 많은 Windows 및 Linux 컴퓨터)에서는 Qt가 그 논리 비트맵을 각 방향으로 두 배 많은 실제 픽셀에 걸쳐 늘립니다. 3334 px 원본에서 200 px로 렌더링한 것을 400 px로 확대하는 셈입니다. 그림의 해상도가 낮은 것이 아니라, 크기 조정이 해상도를 버린 것입니다.

records.source: Qt sends ``DevicePixelRatioChange`` when a window is dragged from a retina laptop onto an ordinary monitor or back. ``redraw`` is the widget's own "put the picture on again" call -- it must scale from the source it kept, not from what is currently on the label, or each move re-scales an already-scaled picture.
records.translation: Qt는 창이 레티나 노트북에서 일반 모니터로, 또는 그 반대로 옮겨질 때 ``DevicePixelRatioChange`` 이벤트를 보냅니다. ``redraw``는 위젯 자체의 "그림 다시 넣기" 호출입니다 -- 현재 레이블에 있는 것이 아니라 보관해 둔 원본에서 크기를 조정해야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 옮길 때마다 이미 크기가 조정된 그림을 다시 조정하게 됩니다.

records.source: The rules:
records.translation: 규칙:

records.context: **QObject receiver requirement.** Connect ``QThread.finished`` to a method on a QObject that belongs to the GUI thread. A closure is unsafe. PySide6 assigns the QThread itself as a closure's receiver. :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` first connects ``thread.finished -> thread.deleteLater``. Slots execute in connection order. DeferredDelete is therefore posted before the closure callback. Qt discards the queued callback after destroying its receiver. The job then remains active and ``active_jobs()`` never reaches zero.
records.label: spacr.qt.job_runner#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``QThread.finished`` must be connected to a **bound method of a GUI-thread QObject**, never a closure. PySide6 makes the QThread itself the receiver for a closure, and :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` connects ``thread.finished -> thread.deleteLater`` first. Slots run in connection order, so the DeferredDelete is posted ahead of the closure's metacall and Qt discards queued events for a destroyed receiver: the job is never retired and ``active_jobs()`` never returns to zero.
records.translation: ``QThread.finished``는 클로저가 아니라 반드시 **GUI 스레드 QObject의 바운드 메서드**에 연결해야 합니다. PySide6은 클로저의 경우 QThread 자체를 수신자로 삼으며, :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` 함수는 ``thread.finished -> thread.deleteLater``를 먼저 연결합니다. 슬롯은 연결 순서대로 실행되므로 DeferredDelete가 클로저의 메타 호출보다 먼저 게시되고, Qt는 소멸된 수신자에 대한 대기 이벤트를 버립니다. 그러면 작업이 절대 정리되지 않고 ``active_jobs()`` 값이 0으로 돌아오지 않습니다.

records.context: What is live instead. An explicit ``QWidget.setFont`` *does* beat the application sheet's ``font-size`` -- it is the same escape hatch that lets a per-widget sheet win -- and it costs one font assignment and one relayout rather than a global unpolish/repolish. So a notch snapshots each visible widget's font once, then re-scales every widget from that snapshot by the ratio the wheel has travelled. The role hierarchy survives because each widget is scaled from its own baseline: a 22 px title and a 13 px caption stay in proportion without this module knowing which is which.

records.source: WHAT IS LIVE INSTEAD. An explicit ``QWidget.setFont`` *does* beat the application sheet's ``font-size`` -- it is the same escape hatch that lets a per-widget sheet win -- and it costs one font assignment and one relayout rather than a global unpolish/repolish. So a notch snapshots each visible widget's font once, then re-scales every widget from that snapshot by the ratio the wheel has travelled. The role hierarchy survives because each widget is scaled from its own baseline: a 22 px title and a 13 px caption stay in proportion without this module knowing which is which.

records.context: What is not live, and why that was accepted. records.context: Two phases:
records.label: spacr.qt.maturity.apply#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Two phases:
records.translation: 두 단계로 이루어집니다.

records.context: 1. :data:`PROMOTIONS` lists applications that were assessed and moved. Applying it repeatedly is safe, and it never *moves an application to a lower stage*. If another component promoted an application further, it stays there. This table represents one assessment; loading it later must not undo a newer assessment. 2. Each registered application absent from all assessment tables and without its own line receives :data:`UNASSESSED_STAGE`. This prevents a new module from inheriting ``stable`` merely because no entry exists. The function writes only empty entries, so it cannot override an author, a plugin, or step 1.
records.label: spacr.qt.maturity.apply#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: 1. :data:`PROMOTIONS` — the apps somebody assessed and moved. Idempotent, and it never *demotes*: a module some other code has already promoted further than this table says stays where it is. That matters because the table is a snapshot of one assessment, and the next assessment should not be silently undone by re-importing this module. 2. Every registered app that is in none of the assessment tables and has no line of its own is written in as :data:`UNASSESSED_STAGE`. This is what stops a new module inheriting ``stable`` from the absence of an entry — see the module docstring. It only ever writes where there is nothing, so it cannot overrule an author, a plugin, or phase 1.
records.translation: 1. :data:`PROMOTIONS` — 누군가 평가하여 단계를 옮긴 앱입니다. 멱등이며 절대 *강등*하지 않습니다. 다른 코드가 이 테이블보다 더 높이 승격한 모듈은 그대로 둡니다. 이 테이블은 한 번의 평가를 담은 스냅숏이므로, 이 모듈을 다시 가져온다고 다음 평가가 조용히 되돌려져서는 안 되기 때문입니다. 2. 어떤 평가 테이블에도 없고 자체 선언도 없는 등록된 모든 앱은 :data:`UNASSESSED_STAGE`로 기록됩니다. 이것이 새 모듈이 항목이 없다는 이유로 ``stable``을 물려받는 것을 막습니다 — 모듈 docstring을 참조하십시오. 아무것도 없는 곳에만 기록하므로, 작성자, 플러그인, 1단계를 뒤집을 수 없습니다.

records.context: The hook is ``QEvent.ToolTip`` rather than hover. It fires exactly when Qt has decided to show a tooltip -- after the same delay, at the same moment -- so the description appears when the user expects it, and returning ``True`` from the filter is what stops the popup being drawn. Reimplementing the timing on ``HoverEnter`` would be a second, slightly different delay for the same gesture.

A screen that contributes a stylesheet block registers it at that import, and ``MainWindow`` applies missing registered blocks to the new screen's own QSS scope before inserting it into the visible stack. :data:`spacr.qt.theme.WIDGET_QSS_MODULES` remains the inventory used when an exhaustive/static stylesheet is explicitly requested.
records.translation: 레지스트리 행에는 화면을 가져올 필요가 없습니다. :mod:`spacr.qt.app_catalog` 모듈이 키, 이름, 문장, 섹션, 단계, 화면 팩토리 이름을 선언하고, :func:`spacr.qt.app_catalog.register_declared` 함수가 아무것도 가져오지 않고 이 모두를 등록합니다. 화면은 누군가 처음 열 때 가져옵니다. 스타일 시트 블록을 제공하는 화면은 그 가져오기 시점에 블록을 등록하며, ``MainWindow``는 새 화면을 보이는 스택에 넣기 전에 등록되었지만 아직 적용되지 않은 블록을 그 화면 자체의 QSS 범위에 적용합니다. :data:`spacr.qt.theme.WIDGET_QSS_MODULES`는 전체/정적 스타일 시트를 명시적으로 요청할 때 사용하는 목록으로 남습니다.

records.context: **Qt Multimedia is touched only on the main GUI execution path.** :class:`_SoundPlayer` owns ``QMediaDevices`` and every ``QSoundEffect`` and lives where the application's event loop does; the dedicated ``QThread`` keeps the part that is genuinely slow, which is synthesizing a sound set (:class:`_SoundRenderer`, numpy and file writes, nothing from Qt Multimedia). Connecting to the sound server is slow -- 354 ms measured on a PipeWire workstation -- so it is made once, on an idle timer after sound is switched on (:meth:`SoundEngine._warm`), and its duration is logged. Playing an already loaded sound is ``play()``, which returns at once: 0.007-0.014 ms on the main GUI execution path against the real stack.
records.label: spacr.qt.sound#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Qt Multimedia is touched only on the GUI thread.** :class:`_SoundPlayer` owns ``QMediaDevices`` and every ``QSoundEffect`` and lives where the application's event loop does; the dedicated ``QThread`` keeps the part that is genuinely slow, which is synthesizing a sound set (:class:`_SoundRenderer`, numpy and file writes, nothing from Qt Multimedia). Connecting to the sound server is slow -- 354 ms measured on a PipeWire workstation -- so it is made once, on an idle timer after sound is switched on (:meth:`SoundEngine._warm`), and its duration is logged. Playing an already loaded sound is ``play()``, which returns at once: 0.007-0.014 ms on the GUI thread against the real stack.
records.translation: **Qt Multimedia는 GUI 스레드에서만 다룹니다.** :class:`_SoundPlayer` 클래스는 ``QMediaDevices``와 모든 ``QSoundEffect``를 소유하며 애플리케이션 이벤트 루프가 있는 곳에 있습니다. 전용 ``QThread``는 실제로 느린 부분, 즉 사운드 세트 합성을 맡습니다(:class:`_SoundRenderer`, numpy와 파일 쓰기이며 Qt Multimedia는 전혀 쓰지 않음). 사운드 서버 연결은 느리므로 -- PipeWire 워크스테이션에서 354 ms로 측정 -- 사운드를 켠 뒤 유휴 타이머에서 한 번만 연결하며(:meth:`SoundEngine._warm`), 걸린 시간을 기록합니다. 이미 불러온 사운드의 재생은 ``play()``이며 즉시 반환됩니다. 실제 스택에서 GUI 스레드 기준 0.007-0.014 ms입니다.

records.context: The rule follows from a crash. Building the effects on the audio independent execution path instead does move the connection off the main GUI execution path -- but Qt Multimedia's device handling belongs to the independent execution path that owns the event loop, so with the FFmpeg backend it enables socket notifiers from the wrong independent execution path. Reopening Preferences with sound on then segfaults, or wedges the interface with an empty Preferences frame until it is force quit.
records.label: spacr.qt.sound#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The rule follows from a crash. Building the effects on the audio thread instead does move the connection off the GUI thread -- but Qt Multimedia's device handling belongs to the thread that owns the event loop, so with the FFmpeg backend it enables socket notifiers from the wrong thread. Reopening Preferences with sound on then segfaults, or wedges the interface with an empty Preferences frame until it is force quit.
records.translation: 이 규칙은 충돌에서 나왔습니다. 대신 오디오 스레드에서 효과를 만들면 연결이 GUI 스레드에서 빠지기는 하지만 -- Qt Multimedia의 장치 처리는 이벤트 루프를 소유한 스레드에 속하므로, FFmpeg 백엔드에서는 잘못된 스레드에서 소켓 알림을 활성화하게 됩니다. 그러면 사운드를 켠 채 Preferences를 다시 열 때 세그멘테이션 오류가 나거나, 강제 종료할 때까지 빈 Preferences 프레임과 함께 인터페이스가 멈춥니다.

records.context: A flood fill from one click is the fastest way to take a whole object, and it has one failure mode that matters: the object touches something bright that is not it -- a debris streak, a saturated membrane seam, the rim of a well -- and the flood walks out along that seam and swallows the microscope field of view. The tolerance that takes the object correctly and the tolerance that escapes are often the same number, so "lower the tolerance" is not an answer: it shrinks the object as well.

The tolerance that takes the object correctly and the tolerance that escapes are often the same number, so "lower the tolerance" is not an answer: it shrinks the object as well.
records.translation: 클릭 한 번으로 하는 영역 채우기는 객체 전체를 가장 빠르게 잡는 방법이며, 중요한 실패 유형은 하나입니다. 객체가 자신이 아닌 밝은 것 -- 잔해 줄무늬, 포화된 막 이음매, 웰 가장자리 -- 에 닿으면, 채우기가 그 이음매를 따라 빠져나가 시야 전체를 삼킵니다. 객체를 올바르게 잡는 허용 오차와 빠져나가는 허용 오차가 같은 숫자인 경우가 많으므로, "lower the tolerance"(허용 오차 낮추기)는 해답이 아닙니다. 객체까지 줄어들기 때문입니다.

records.context: The masthead builds this label with ``setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Maximum, ...)`` and ``setMinimumWidth(0)`` and documents the intent -- the blurb "may shrink below its ideal width rather than force the window wider". Neither call achieves it: ``qSmartMinSize`` takes a shrinkable widget's minimum from ``minimumSizeHint()``, which for a non-wrapping ``QLabel`` is the width of the entire sentence, and it only lets an explicit ``minimumWidth`` override that when the value is greater than zero. Without this override the blurb, the one masthead control that can lose text harmlessly, gave up no width.

records.source: The masthead builds this label with ``setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Maximum, ...)`` and ``setMinimumWidth(0)`` and documents the intent -- the blurb "may shrink below its ideal width rather than force the window wider". Neither call achieves it: ``qSmartMinSize`` takes a shrinkable widget's minimum from ``minimumSizeHint()``, which for a non-wrapping ``QLabel`` is the width of the entire sentence, and it only lets an explicit ``minimumWidth`` override that when the value is greater than zero. Without this override the blurb, the one masthead control that can lose text harmlessly, gave up no width.
records.translation: 머리 영역은 ``setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Maximum, ...)`` 및 ``setMinimumWidth(0)``으로 이 레이블을 만들고 의도를 문서화합니다 -- 소개 문구는 "창을 넓히기보다는 이상적인 너비 아래로 줄어들 수 있다". 두 호출 모두 이를 이루지 못합니다. ``qSmartMinSize``는 줄어들 수 있는 위젯의 최솟값을 ``minimumSizeHint()``에서 가져오는데, 줄 바꿈하지 않는 ``QLabel``에서는 그것이 문장 전체의 너비이며, 명시적 ``minimumWidth`` 값은 0보다 클 때만 이를 재정의할 수 있습니다. 이 재정의가 없으면 텍스트를 잃어도 해가 없는 유일한 머리 영역 컨트롤인 소개 문구가 너비를 전혀 양보하지 않았습니다.

records.context: The body's own visibility stays under its owner's control. The fold hides an inner holder, never the body, so unfolding cannot show a panel its owner hid or build a panel that is built on first show. The other way round, the section follows its body: while the owner keeps the body hidden the whole section -- heading included -- is hidden too, and it comes back when the owner shows the body. Only the body's hidden flag is read for that, so nothing is shown, measured or built to find out.

records.context: ``QColorDialog.getColor`` defaults to the *platform's* colour chooser. On a GNOME desktop with ``xdg-desktop-portal`` running, that is not a Qt widget at all: Qt asks the portal, the portal starts (or wakes) the GTK implementation over D-Bus, and the dialog can be slow to appear. Every colour picker in the tree was reached through an unguarded ``getColor`` — six of them, none passing ``DontUseNativeDialog``.

records.context: The portal round trip **cannot be reproduced headless**: an offscreen Qt never asks the portal, so no test in this suite can observe the stall or its absence. The restyle work itself is free (``set_line_style`` 0.000 s on a 1,200 point plot) so the wait is in the dialog — and "the portal is what the wait is" is a named, checkable hypothesis to be confirmed on a real display, not something this file proves. What IS proven here, by ``tests/qt/test_colour_picker.py``, is that no call site can ask for the platform dialog any more.

records.source: Lifted out of `spacr.qt.screens.settings_model`, where it was written for the settings panel's chip strip, because a wrapping row is not a settings idea: the regression results header wants one too. records.translation: 설정 패널의 칩 띠를 위해 `spacr.qt.screens.settings_model` 모듈에 작성되었던 것을 꺼냈습니다. 줄 바꿈되는 행은 설정에만 해당하는 개념이 아니며, 회귀 결과 머리글에도 필요하기 때문입니다. 최소 너비가 있는 콤보 박스 세 개, 길이를 예측할 수 없는 실행 이름, QHBoxLayout은 좁은 패널에 들어가지 않으며, Qt는 만족시킬 수 없는 상자에 대해 자식들이 겹치게 둡니다 -- 577 px에서 측정한 결과, 두 번째 상자가 첫 번째 상자 안쪽 48 px에서 시작했고 세 번째 상자는 패널 밖으로 32 px 넘어갔습니다.

records.context: the CPU renderer does true spatial 2x2 supersampling inside one frame -- four samples of the same instant, averaged. The orbit pattern's CPU path jitters across four frames instead, which is cheaper but blends different animation times. That is the reason this one costs four times as much per pixel and renders a quarter of the pixels to pay for it.

records.source: the CPU renderer does TRUE SPATIAL 2x2 supersampling inside one frame -- four samples of the same instant, averaged. The orbit pattern's CPU path jitters across four frames instead, which is cheaper but blends different animation times. That is the reason this one costs four times as much per pixel and renders a quarter of the pixels to pay for it.
records.translation: CPU 렌더러는 한 프레임 안에서 진정한 공간 2x2 슈퍼샘플링을 합니다 -- 같은 순간의 표본 네 개를 평균합니다. 궤도 패턴의 CPU 경로는 대신 네 프레임에 걸쳐 흔들림을 주는데, 이는 더 저렴하지만 서로 다른 애니메이션 시각을 섞습니다. 이것이 이 패턴이 픽셀당 네 배의 비용이 들고, 그 비용을 치르기 위해 픽셀의 4분의 1만 렌더링하는 이유입니다.

records.context: Why it is a second entry rather than a backend switch. The CPU path jitters four samples ACROSS four frames, which averages four different animation times; a GPU pass can afford the four samples inside one instant. They are not the same picture, so offering them as one option with a hidden backend would mean the same setting drawing two things. "Orbit fold" is taken, so this is "Orbit fold (sharp)" -- descriptive of what actually differs rather than a version number.

records.source: WHY IT IS A SECOND ENTRY RATHER THAN A BACKEND SWITCH. The CPU path jitters four samples ACROSS four frames, which averages four different animation times; a GPU pass can afford the four samples inside one instant. They are not the same picture, so offering them as one option with a hidden backend would mean the same setting drawing two things. "Orbit fold" is taken, so this is "Orbit fold (sharp)" -- descriptive of what actually differs rather than a version number.
records.translation: 백엔드 스위치가 아니라 두 번째 항목인 이유. CPU 경로는 네 표본을 네 프레임에 걸쳐 흔들어 서로 다른 애니메이션 시각 넷을 평균하지만, GPU 패스는 한 순간 안에서 네 표본을 감당할 수 있습니다. 둘은 같은 그림이 아니므로, 숨겨진 백엔드가 있는 하나의 옵션으로 제공하면 같은 설정이 두 가지를 그리게 됩니다. "Orbit fold"(궤도 접기)는 이미 쓰이고 있으므로 이것은 "Orbit fold (sharp)"(궤도 접기, 선명)입니다 -- 버전 번호가 아니라 실제로 다른 점을 설명하는 이름입니다.

The sampling setting lives here because it is the answer to the module being laggy on a real dataset -- a screen of a million objects is slow to draw, slow to hit-test, and no more informative than a fifth of them. ``2D`` Gating on a scatter: the tools, the shapes, and the clustering that proposes shapes for you. ``3D`` Gating in a volume. The settings are here; the workspace they drive is the next piece of work.
records.translation: ``General`` 얼마나 많은 데이터를 불러오고 점 구름을 어떻게 그리는지입니다. 표본 추출 설정이 여기 있는 이유는 실제 데이터 세트에서 모듈이 느려지는 문제에 대한 해답이기 때문입니다 -- 객체 백만 개의 화면은 그리기도, 적중 판정도 느리며, 그 5분의 1보다 더 많은 정보를 주지도 않습니다. ``2D`` 산점도에서의 게이팅입니다. 도구, 도형, 그리고 도형을 제안하는 군집화입니다. ``3D`` 볼륨에서의 게이팅입니다. 설정은 여기 있고, 그 설정이 구동하는 작업 공간은 다음 작업입니다.

records.source: Every setting is a field on :class:`GateEditorSettings`, which is a plain frozen dataclass -- no Qt -- so what the editor does with a setting can be tested without building a dialog, and so the whole set can be written to disk as one thing later.
records.translation: 모든 설정은 :class:`GateEditorSettings`의 필드이며, 이는 Qt가 없는 평범한 고정 dataclass입니다 -- 그래서 편집기가 설정으로 무엇을 하는지를 대화 상자를 만들지 않고도 테스트할 수 있고, 나중에 전체 집합을 하나로 디스크에 기록할 수 있습니다.

records.context: **Sampling is a display concern only.** A data-selection boundary drawn on 20% of the objects is still a statement about all of them; the export re-reads the full table and applies the data-selection boundary there (:func:`spacr.filters.gate_mask_over_table`). Nothing downstream of the plot ever sees the sample.

records.context: Layers are composited with the "over" operator, bottom first. The canvas starts black. Each ticked layer, bottom first, is laid on with its opacity ``a``: where it covers, ``out = out * (1 - a) + colour * a``; where it does not, ``out`` is left alone. An image covers every pixel; a mask covers its objects only, so the background of a mask never dims what is under it. The result is rounded to the nearest whole grey level.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.mask_comparison#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Layers are composited with the "over" operator, bottom first. The canvas starts black. Each ticked layer, bottom first, is laid on with its opacity ``a``: where it covers, ``out = out * (1 - a) + colour * a``; where it does not, ``out`` is left alone. An image covers every pixel; a mask covers its objects only, so the background of a mask never dims what is under it. The result is rounded to the nearest whole grey level.
records.translation: 레이어는 "over"(위에 덮기) 연산자로 아래부터 합성됩니다. 캔버스는 검은색으로 시작합니다. 체크된 각 레이어를 아래부터 불투명도 ``a``로 얹습니다. 덮는 곳에서는 ``out = out * (1 - a) + colour * a``이고, 덮지 않는 곳에서는 ``out``을 그대로 둡니다. 이미지는 모든 픽셀을 덮고, 마스크는 객체만 덮으므로 마스크의 배경이 그 아래를 어둡게 하지 않습니다. 결과는 가장 가까운 정수 회색 수준으로 반올림됩니다.

records.context: A popup appearing over this bar is a bug, and not one this bar causes: nothing here asks for one -- the bar sets no tooltip on itself or on anything in it. Qt propagates an unhandled ``QEvent.ToolTip`` up the parent chain, and :func:`spacr.qt.module_hints.install_module_hints` filters the whole application, so the request walked up from this label to an ancestor carrying ``moduleAppKey`` and that ancestor's popup appeared over the strip that exists to replace popups.

records.source: A popup appearing over this bar is a bug, and not one this bar causes: nothing here asks for one -- the bar sets no tooltip on itself or on anything in it. Qt propagates an unhandled ``QEvent.ToolTip`` up the parent chain, and :func:`spacr.qt.module_hints.install_module_hints` filters the whole application, so the request walked up from this label to an ancestor carrying ``moduleAppKey`` and that ancestor's popup appeared over the strip that exists to replace popups.
records.translation: 이 막대 위에 팝업이 나타나는 것은 버그이며, 이 막대가 일으키는 버그가 아닙니다. 여기서는 팝업을 요청하지 않습니다 -- 막대는 자신이나 그 안의 어떤 것에도 툴팁을 설정하지 않습니다. Qt는 처리되지 않은 ``QEvent.ToolTip``을 부모 체인으로 올려 보내고, :func:`spacr.qt.module_hints.install_module_hints` 함수는 애플리케이션 전체를 필터링하므로, 요청이 이 레이블에서 ``moduleAppKey``를 가진 조상까지 올라가 그 조상의 팝업이 팝업을 대신하려고 존재하는 띠 위에 나타났습니다.

records.context: One widget serves two owners. A segmentation preview has four things worth looking at: the image with the outlines on it, the label masks alone, the flow microscope field of view the masks were pooled from, and the cell probability the flow was thresholded at. Mask generation's live preview showed three of them through a dropdown; the plaque preview showed its own four through tabs, drawn by its own code. This module is the one place both can draw them from, so that a change to how a cell probability is coloured reaches both previews at once.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.segmentation_views#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: One widget serves two owners. A segmentation preview has four things worth looking at: the image with the outlines on it, the label masks alone, the flow field the masks were pooled from, and the cell probability the flow was thresholded at. Mask generation's live preview showed three of them through a dropdown; the plaque preview showed its own four through tabs, drawn by its own code. This module is the one place both can draw them from, so that a change to how a cell probability is coloured reaches both previews at once.
records.translation: 하나의 위젯이 두 소유자를 지원합니다. 분할 미리 보기에서 볼 만한 것은 네 가지입니다. 윤곽선이 그려진 이미지, 레이블 마스크만, 마스크를 모아 만든 흐름장, 흐름에 임계값을 적용한 세포 확률입니다. 마스크 생성의 실시간 미리 보기는 드롭다운으로 그중 세 가지를 보여 주었고, 플라크 미리 보기는 자체 코드로 그린 네 가지를 탭으로 보여 주었습니다. 이 모듈은 둘 다 그것들을 그릴 수 있는 단일 장소이므로, 세포 확률의 색을 칠하는 방식을 바꾸면 두 미리 보기에 동시에 반영됩니다.

records.source: The widget works on arrays, not modules. It is handed an image, label masks, flow pictures and cell probability maps -- each either one array or one per object -- and draws whichever of :data:`VIEWS` is chosen. Nothing in here names the Mask module, Cellpose settings or a plaque.
records.translation: 위젯은 모듈이 아니라 배열을 다룹니다. 이미지, 레이블 마스크, 흐름 그림, 세포 확률 맵 -- 각각 배열 하나 또는 객체마다 하나 -- 을 받아 :data:`VIEWS` 중 선택된 것을 그립니다. 여기의 어떤 것도 Mask 모듈, Cellpose 설정, 플라크를 지칭하지 않습니다.

records.context: An owner can replace renderers. The default renderers draw a plain overlay, categorical masks, the flows as Cellpose hands them and the probability on the magma scale. An owner with its own idea of an outline -- the live preview's colour choice and thickness -- registers a renderer for that view with :meth:`SegmentationViews.set_renderer` and keeps the other three. A renderer answers with a picture, with a sentence to show in the picture's place, or with ``None`` for the widget's own "nothing yet" sentence.

records.source: An owner can replace renderers. The default renderers draw a plain overlay, categorical masks, the flows as Cellpose hands them and the probability on the magma scale. records.context: What this module adds is the tie. Two views of the same region are only worth putting side by side if they stay in register: a curator comparing a field with its enhanced self is looking for a difference between them, and a difference in where the two are pointing is the one difference that is not information. :meth:`ZoomableImageView.link_to` makes a group of views share one zoom and one scroll position, so zooming or panning any of them moves all of them.

records.source: What this module adds is the tie. Two views of the same region are only worth putting side by side if they stay in register: a curator comparing a field with its enhanced self is looking for a difference between them, and a difference in where the two are pointing is the one difference that is not information. :meth:`ZoomableImageView.link_to` makes a group of views share one zoom and one scroll position, so zooming or panning any of them moves all of them.
records.translation: 이 모듈이 더하는 것은 연결입니다. 같은 영역의 두 보기는 서로 정렬된 상태를 유지할 때만 나란히 놓을 가치가 있습니다. 시야와 그 향상된 버전을 비교하는 큐레이터는 둘 사이의 차이를 찾고 있으며, 둘이 가리키는 위치의 차이는 정보가 아닌 유일한 차이입니다. :meth:`ZoomableImageView.link_to` 메서드는 여러 보기가 하나의 확대 배율과 하나의 스크롤 위치를 공유하게 하므로, 어느 하나를 확대/축소하거나 이동하면 모두 움직입니다.
